name: GTI_AI_Analysis
author: Luca Memini
description: Ask the Google Threat Intelligence AI agent to assess an observable. Returns a short result (one-line verdict) and a long descriptive result. A custom context prompt can be configured; observable and context are sanitized and fenced to mitigate prompt injection.

configurationItems.name: api_key
configurationItems.description: Google Threat Intelligence API key (Enterprise / Enterprise Plus / Integration Advanced)

configurationItems.name: context_prompt
configurationItems.description: Trusted context for the AI (e.g. organization profile, sectors, what is considered critical). Plain text, max 2000 chars. It is placed in the instruction section; instruction-like markup is stripped.

configurationItems.name: language
configurationItems.description: Language of short and long results

configurationItems.name: timeout
configurationItems.description: HTTP timeout in seconds (GTI agent sessions can be slow)
